subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name` fields?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the exact JSON/text shape becomes agent-visible channel behavior and affects compatibility with existing command-style button actions.

options.title: Refresh the linked structured passthrough PR
options.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953 so simple button commands stay unchanged while form/input/select fields are exposed in a documented structured payload.

options.title: Limit the first fix to form submissions
options.body: Ship only `form_value` passthrough first and leave selector/input payload shape to a follow-up if maintainers want a smaller compatibility surface.

options.title: Keep card actions command-only
options.body: Decline general passthrough and require richer Feishu forms to use a custom plugin HTTP callback route instead.

recommendation.title: Refresh the linked structured passthrough PR
recommendation.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953 so simple button commands stay unchanged while form/input/select fields are exposed in a documented structured payload.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu/Lark plugin package declares this handle as the community maintainer, making them the best available owner for the channel behavior contract.
